problem: Which of the following expressions gives all of the vertical asymptotes of the function $y=\operatorname{tan}⁡(2x)-2,$ where $x$ is measured in degrees? Assume that $n$ is an integer.

feedback.problem: Which of the following expressions gives all of the vertical asymptotes of the function  $f(x)=\operatorname{cot}⁡(\pi x)?$ Assume that $n$ is an integer.
feedback.worked_solution:
The asymptotes of $y=\operatorname{cot}⁡x$ are given by the expression

$$
x=n\pi ,
$$

where $n$ is an integer.

To find the asymptotes of $\operatorname{cot}⁡(\pi x),$ we replace the $x$ on the left-hand side of the above with $(\pi x).$ This gives

$$
\pi x=n\pi .
$$

Solving for $x,$ we get 

$$
\begin{aligned}\pi x & =n\pi  \\ x & =n.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we conclude that the expression giving all the vertical asymptotes is $x=n,$ where $n$ is an integer.
